# Each submit scope reports the actual command that invoked generation.

as 'Test <test@example.com>'
at '2026-11-06T18:00:00Z'

cd repo
git init
git commit --allow-empty -m Initial
shamhub-setup
shamhub new origin alice/example.git
shamhub register alice
git push origin main
env SHAMHUB_USERNAME=alice
gs auth login
git config spice.message.fill.command mock-message
env MOCK_MESSAGE_RESPONSE=$WORK/message.txt
env MOCK_MESSAGE_RECORD=$WORK/invocation

git add one.txt
gs branch create one -m One
git rev-parse HEAD^ HEAD
cp stdout $WORK/range.txt
gs --no-prompt branch submit --fill --no-draft
stderr 'Created #1'
cmp $WORK/invocation/range $WORK/range.txt
grep '^One$' $WORK/invocation/draft
grep '^branch-submit$' $WORK/invocation/operation

git add two.txt
gs branch create two -m Two
gs --no-prompt upstack submit --fill --no-draft
stderr 'Created #2'
grep '^upstack-submit$' $WORK/invocation/operation

git add three.txt
gs branch create three -m Three
gs --no-prompt stack submit --fill --no-draft
stderr 'Created #3'
grep '^stack-submit$' $WORK/invocation/operation

git add four.txt
gs branch create four -m Four
gs --no-prompt downstack submit --fill --no-draft
stderr 'Created #4'
grep '^downstack-submit$' $WORK/invocation/operation

-- repo/one.txt --
one
-- repo/two.txt --
two
-- repo/three.txt --
three
-- repo/four.txt --
four
-- message.txt --
Generated
